description: SayItem is a mod where you must speak words and phrases in different languages to unlock items

mods.name: SayItem
mods.description: Say item names in other languages to unlock them. Whisper, its multilingual model, and all gameplay run inside Minecraft. Inspired by custom mods seen on YouTube; see README credits.

releases.notes:
German pronunciation support from PR #1 was merged with RewardedIvan's original commits preserved. This release fixes its compilation/output issues and adds prefix-boundary and common German sound rules, a reading key, and regression tests. Guides remain approximate; packs can override readings.

Other changes:
- Optional GPU Turbo profile with the multilingual large-v3-turbo Q5 model (574 MB download). Existing CPU, GPU Base and GPU Small profiles remain available. Choose in K settings and rejoin.
- Valid Greek egg spelling variants and traditional Chinese answers are accepted.
- Recordings can last up to 12 seconds. Finish speaking before the challenge deadline; recognition then pauses the timer for at most 15 seconds. Failed answers resume the time left.
- Stale recording callbacks cannot submit answers to a newer challenge. Shared unlocks, disconnects and language reloads keep the queue's timing consistent.
- Restore Minecraft language codes such as tok correctly and recover CPU settings on platforms without GPU support.

Human recording checks on an RX 570: at 90% text matching, GPU Base accepted 42/120 item recordings (0.33 s median), GPU Small 67/120 (0.68 s), and GPU Turbo 74/120 (1.98 s). Turbo is more accurate overall but also regresses on some words. The sample covers 25 languages and limited voices; six Finnish whole-sentence controls are separate. Recognition is not reliable for every item. Full transcripts, sources, licenses and coverage limits are in tools/speech-accuracy.json and the source manifests.

Verified builds and isolated jar speech for Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3, plus CPU/GPU cancellation, silence and long recordings. No live game frame-rate or microphone test. Install the matching jar with Fabric Loader and Fabric API; update multiplayer clients and server together. Jars contain no other mods, native engines or model weights.

releases.notes:
SayItem 0.8.0 adds 17 languages, random item languages, and optional Minecraft interface-language matching.

Languages
- 26 built-in packs, each covering all 1,657 item entries across the supported versions.
- Added Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Czech, Slovak, Ukrainian, Greek, Turkish, Hungarian, Romanian, Korean, Chinese, Indonesian, and Vietnamese.
- All 26 language identifiers were checked against the actual multilingual Whisper vocabulary. Recognition still depends on pronunciation, recording quality, model, and item name. The new languages have not all been tested with native-speaker recordings.

K > Language
- Choose a language from the paged picker, or select Random per item.
- Random mode chooses once for the active item challenge. Retries and reconnects keep its choice; the next challenge gets another draw. Unlocks still apply across languages.
- Match Minecraft language changes the game's menus and item names to the challenge language. It is off by default.
- Timers pause during language resource reloads. Disabling matching or leaving the world restores your previous language. The original preference is saved for recovery after a restart.

Text cleanup
- Removed em dashes from the shipped project text and shortened README/UI wording with Avoid AI Writing.
- Existing custom packs, readings, saved unlocks, and sharing remain supported.

Install the jar matching Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2, or 26.3, plus Fabric Loader and Fabric API. Update multiplayer clients and server together. No Python or companion app. Ordinary speech libraries/models are downloaded separately on first use.

Validation: builds and isolated jar speech checks for all three versions, full pack coverage, actual Whisper language tokens, stable random choices, queue deadlines, reload serialization/restoration/failure recovery, world progress, and CPU recognition. HUD/picker layout and the Minecraft API integration were checked from source; a live in-game interface-language test was not performed.

releases.notes:
SayItem 0.7.1 adds Italian and Latin reading guides, and moves the unlock counter to the bottom-left HUD.

- The unlock counter stays in the lower-left corner during and between challenges. On small GUI viewports it moves above the vanilla hotbar/stats, and hides while chat is open.
- Italian includes all 1,657 vanilla item entries across the supported Minecraft versions.
- K settings > Readings toggles Latin-letter guides under the original item name. Enabled by default.
- Russian/Bulgarian guides use language-specific spellings; Japanese keeps its existing romaji. Other scripts can use Minecraft's client-side text conversion where supported.
- Custom pack readings remain untouched. Blank readings gain automatic guides without rewriting existing pack files. Guides are approximate, do not mark stress, and never change which speech answers unlock an item.
- Dedicated servers do not need any extra text-conversion library. Speech engines, GPU profiles, saved unlocks, and shared progress keep their existing behavior.

Install the jar matching Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2, or 26.3, plus Fabric Loader and Fabric API. Update clients/server together. No Python, companion app, or nested mods.

Validation: all three Minecraft builds and isolated jar speech checks; full Italian pack coverage; Cyrillic guides, sample custom scripts, custom-reading preservation, and a server classloader without client text libraries. HUD layout was checked from source; no live game screenshot test was performed.

releases.notes:
SayItem 0.7.0 adds optional local GPU speech, Bulgarian and Russian packs, and world-owned unlock progress.

- K settings: choose CPU Base, GPU Base, or GPU Small; rejoin to apply. Windows x64 Vulkan support was tested on a Radeon RX 570 4 GB. Unsupported GPUs fall back to CPU Base.
- Warm recorded-speech benchmark on that PC: CPU Base median 2.32 s, GPU Base 0.42 s, GPU Small 0.96 s. GPU Small matched more phrases in this small test set, but short words can still be misrecognized. These measurements exclude Minecraft rendering load.
- Bulgarian and Russian cover all 1,657 vanilla item types across the supported versions.
- HUD and K settings show unlocked / total item types.
- World owners/operators can enable shared unlocks. Existing progress merges; disabling sharing keeps unlocks already received.
- Unlocks and sharing survive reconnects/server restarts in world/data/sayitem-unlocks.json. Reconnecting pauses active timers while speech prepares.

Install the jar matching your Minecraft version, plus Fabric Loader and Fabric API. Update multiplayer clients and server together. No Python or companion app; libraries and models download on first use. The mod jars are about 340 KiB and contain no nested mods or model weights.

Validation: builds and isolated jar speech checks for Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2, and 26.3; CPU recognition, Cyrillic packs, shared progress/save-reload, actual Vulkan recognition, cancellation, and CPU fallback tests. No live Minecraft microphone/FPS test was performed.

releases.notes:
SayItem 0.6.0 for Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3 (Fabric).

- Locked item types now form a first-in, first-out queue for each player. Only the current item's timer runs.
- Waiting types keep their full configured 10–30 seconds. Their countdown starts when the preceding challenge is unlocked or times out.
- Duplicate stacks and retries do not reset or reorder the queue. A timeout removes only the active locked type; collect it again to retry at the back of the queue.
- The HUD shows how many item types are queued. Old or queued speech attempts cannot skip the current challenge.
- Unlocks still last for the run and survive reconnects. Timer settings and the required text match are unchanged.

The speech model remains multilingual Whisper Base using CTranslate2 INT8 on the CPU, as in 0.4.0. No GPU support is added in this release. Fabric API remains a separate dependency; the model/runtime download once.

Update the server and all players together. See README for installation, controls, and custom language packs.
